abstract: [European heart journal] A major challenge in dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) care is the identification and management of individuals at risk before disease manifestation. An artificial intelligence (AI) model applied to electrocardiography (ECG) was developed to detect and predict the echocardiographic DCM phenotype (left ventricular dilatation with systolic dysfunction) and was evaluated for its ability to stratify the risk of incident DCM in familial cohorts. A deep learning model was trained to detect the echocardiographic DCM phenotype and to predict its future onset, using more than 330 000 ECG-echocardiogram pairs from the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, Boston. Model performance was validated in cohorts from the UK Biobank, Zhongshan Hospital, and Antwerp University Hospital, and compared with models based on traditional ECG features and echocardiographic traits. To assess performance in familial DCM, genetically predisposed individuals identified through cascade screening at the cardiogenetics clinics of Antwerp University Hospital (n = 166, 18% DCM positive) and Maastricht University Medical Center (n = 177, 18% DCM positive) were evaluated. The AI-ECG model achieved areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve of .87-.97 for diagnosing the prevalent DCM phenotype, outperforming traditional ECG parameters. AI-ECG was comparable to echocardiography for predicting future DCM (C-index .80-.87 and .80-.90, respectively). In familial cohorts, 5-year negative predictive values were 95.5% (Antwerp) and 91.5% (Maastricht), with corresponding positive predictive values of 42.4% and 39.4%, while high-risk scores were associated with a 5.1-6.4-fold increased risk of incident DCM. The explainable AI-ECG model detects the echocardiographic DCM phenotype and predicts future disease, and supports the exclusion of short- to mid-term disease in genetically at-risk individuals. This low-cost tool could help reduce surveillance burden and facilitate earlier intervention.
zh_abstract: [European heart journal] 扩张型心肌病（DCM）诊疗中的一项主要挑战是在疾病出现临床表现之前识别并管理高危个体。研究开发了一种应用于心电图（ECG）的人工智能（AI）模型，用于检测和预测超声心动图DCM表型（左心室扩大伴收缩功能障碍），并评估其在家族性队列中对新发DCM风险分层的能力。利用波士顿贝斯以色列女执事医疗中心超过33万对ECG-超声心动图数据训练深度学习模型，以检测超声心动图DCM表型并预测其未来发生。模型性能在英国生物银行（UK Biobank）、中山医院和安特卫普大学医院的队列中进行了验证，并与基于传统ECG特征和超声心动图指标的模型进行了比较。为评估其在家族性DCM中的表现，对安特卫普大学医院（n = 166，18%为DCM阳性）和马斯特里赫特大学医学中心（n = 177，18%为DCM阳性）心脏遗传学门诊通过级联筛查确定的遗传易感个体进行了评估。AI-ECG模型诊断现患DCM表型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积为.87-.97，优于传统ECG参数。在预测未来DCM方面，AI-ECG与超声心动图相当（C指数分别为.80-.87和.80-.90）。在家族性队列中，5年阴性预测值分别为95.5%（安特卫普）和91.5%（马斯特里赫特），相应的阳性预测值分别为42.4%和39.4%，而高风险评分与新发DCM风险增加5.1-6.4倍相关。这一可解释的AI-ECG模型可检测超声心动图DCM表型并预测未来疾病，并有助于在遗传高危个体中排除短至中期发病。这一低成本工具有助于减轻随访监测负担并促进早期干预。

abstract: [Experimental dermatology] Deep neural networks classify dermoscopic and clinical images of skin lesions with accuracy that matches, and in curated comparisons exceeds, experienced dermatologists. Regulators have responded: an elastic scattering spectroscopy device with an embedded classifier is authorised for primary care in the United States, an image-based system has conditional approval in the National Health Service, and consumer applications are marketed directly to the public. In this Viewpoint we argue that clinical deployment is advancing faster than the experimental evidence that investigative dermatology would normally demand. Performance measured on internal test sets falls when algorithms are exposed to external images, non-dermoscopic photographs or other populations. Networks learn confounders, such as surgical ink markings, as readily as morphology, and the histopathological reference standard is itself subject to substantial observer variation. Public training datasets record skin phototype for about 2% of images and contain almost no darkest-phototype, acral or nail images. Regulated devices with prospective evidence achieve high sensitivity or negative predictive value at the cost of low specificity, shifting referral and biopsy rates with unmeasured effects on patient outcomes and overdiagnosis, and the single randomised trial to date improved diagnostic accuracy, chiefly among non-dermatologists, without measuring those outcomes. We identify where the largest gains lie, in primary care, allied health and under-served regions, and propose an experimental agenda: phototype-stratified external validation, shortcut-detection and counterfactual explanation studies, consensus histopathological labelling, pragmatic randomised trials with outcome endpoints reported to CONSORT-AI, and post-market surveillance under the European Medical Device Regulation and Artificial Intelligence Act.
zh_abstract: [Experimental dermatology] 深度神经网络对皮肤病变的皮肤镜图像和临床图像进行分类，其准确度可与经验丰富的皮肤科医生相当，在经过筛选的比较中甚至更高。监管机构已作出回应：一种内置分类器的弹性散射光谱设备已在美国获准用于基层医疗，一种基于图像的系统在英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）获得有条件批准，面向公众的消费类应用也已直接上市。在这篇观点文章中，我们认为临床部署的推进速度快于研究性皮肤病学通常要求的实验证据。当算法面对外部图像、非皮肤镜照片或其他人群时，在内部测试集上测得的性能会下降。网络学习混杂因素（如手术墨水标记）与学习形态学特征一样容易，而且组织病理学参考标准本身也存在显著的观察者间差异。公开训练数据集仅约2%的图像记录了皮肤光型，几乎不包含最深肤色光型、肢端或甲部图像。具有前瞻性证据的受监管设备以低特异度为代价获得高敏感度或高阴性预测值，这改变了转诊和活检率，对患者结局和过度诊断产生未被测量的影响；迄今唯一的随机试验提高了诊断准确度（主要见于非皮肤科医生），但未测量这些结局。我们指出最大获益所在，即基层医疗、联合健康服务和服务不足地区，并提出一项实验议程：按光型分层的外部验证、捷径检测和反事实解释研究、共识性组织病理学标注、按 CONSORT-AI 报告含结局终点的实用随机试验，以及在欧盟医疗器械法规和人工智能法案下的上市后监测。

abstract: [Insights into imaging] To assess performance and agreement of a commercial artificial intelligence (AI) tool relative to routine pediatric radiologists' bone age assessments in a large pediatric cohort, with focus on different groups of growth disorders. One thousand five hundred sixteen anterior-posterior hand radiographs of pediatric patients (50.6% boys, mean age 10.84 ± 3.66 years) were retrospectively analyzed using the AI tool BoneAge. abstract: [Journal of computer-aided molecular design] AI models such as foundation models and generative models have shown promise for aiding drug discovery alongside traditional cheminformatics and bioinformatics tools and physics-based approaches. In this study, we design a workflow that integrates these AI methods to generate molecules alongside established informatic and predictive filtering approaches to streamline downselection of molecules from the massive and noisy result sets generated by AI. This workflow evaluates generative methods based on validity, reliability, diversity, similarity, hallucination and campaign needs. Analyses are made on the original proprietary dataset to determine molecular property thresholds for screening criteria. Overall, 249 molecules are selected from ~ 5 million generated molecules. 18 molecules are then validated with free energy perturbation simulations. 5 out of 5 retain on target inhibition, with IC50 values below 1 μM. 1 of the 5 experimentally validated molecules displayed greater inhibition than the corresponding lead molecule. Predictive foundation model MMELON yields Pearson correlation R = 0.72 in blind test, showing potential for future drug discovery campaigns.
zh_abstract: [Journal of computer-aided molecular design] 基础模型和生成模型等 AI 模型与传统化学信息学、生物信息学工具及基于物理的方法一样，在辅助药物发现方面展现出前景。在本研究中，我们设计了一个工作流程，将这些 AI 方法与成熟的信息学和预测性筛选方法相结合以生成分子，从而从 AI 产生的海量且含噪声的结果集中简化分子的下游筛选。该工作流程基于有效性、可靠性、多样性、相似性、幻觉以及项目需求来评估生成方法。对原始专有数据集进行分析，以确定用于筛选标准的分子性质阈值。总体上，从约 500 万个生成分子中选出 249 个分子。随后用自由能微扰模拟验证了其中 18 个分子。5 个分子中的 5 个保留了对靶点的抑制作用，IC50 值低于 1 μM。5 个经实验验证的分子中有 1 个表现出比相应先导分子更强的抑制作用。预测性基础模型 MMELON 在盲测中的 Pearson 相关系数 R = 0.72，显示出其用于未来药物发现项目的潜力。

abstract: [Science advances] Electrodermal activity (EDA), a primary stress-sensing signal in today's wearables, requires skin-electrode contact that drifts and degrades over time, limiting long-term use. Here, we present an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered ring for all-optical sensing of dermal activity (ODA), using light rather than electrodes to track sweat gland activation, thereby enhancing durability and comfort. An optimized dual-wavelength design (960 and 1250 nanometers) captures perspiration dynamics while concurrently recording photoplethysmography. The ODA ring integrates temperature and motion sensors for multimodal monitoring with on-device inference. In correlation studies, ODA and EDA signals showed 86% agreement. In classification tasks, the ODA ring achieved 92.3% binary accuracy versus 77.95% for EDA. In multiclass tasks, ODA outperforms EDA by 100 to 74.58% (short term) and 89.72 to 43.20% (long term). On-device one-dimensional convolutional neural network inference enabled 87.53% autonomous accuracy. This electrode-free modality establishes a scalable, all-optical platform for rings, watches, and patches for accurate, robust, and long-term stress monitoring.
zh_abstract: 皮肤电活动（EDA）是当今可穿戴设备中主要的压力感知信号，但需要皮肤与电极接触，而这种接触会随时间漂移和退化，限制了长期使用。在此，我们提出一种由人工智能（AI）驱动的指环，用于真皮活动的全光学感测（ODA），以光而非电极来追踪汗腺激活，从而提高耐用性和舒适度。一种经优化的双波长设计（960和1250纳米）可捕捉出汗动态，同时记录光电容积脉搏波。该ODA指环集成了温度和运动传感器，用于多模态监测并支持设备端推理。在相关性研究中，ODA与EDA信号的一致性为86%。在分类任务中，ODA指环的二分类准确率为92.3%，而EDA为77.95%。在多分类任务中，ODA优于EDA：短期为100%对74.58%，长期为89.72%对43.20%。设备端一维卷积神经网络推理实现了87.53%的自主准确率。这种无电极方式为指环、手表和贴片建立了一个可扩展的全光学平台，可用于准确、稳健且长期的压力监测。

abstract: [Thyroid : official journal of the American Thyroid Association] Differentiated thyroid cancer (DTC) generally carries an excellent prognosis, yet recurrence occurs in up to 8-9% of patients. Artificial intelligence (AI) models are increasingly proposed to predict DTC recurrence; however, their methodological quality and clinical readiness are poorly defined. We conducted a systematic review to evaluate the methodological quality, risk of bias, and applicability of these models using the PROBAST + AI framework. We searched Ovid MEDLINE, Embase, Cochrane databases, Scopus, and Web of Science from inception to July 13, 2026. Eligible studies included original research developing or validating AI models for recurrence in DTC. Model quality (for development), risk of bias (for evaluation), and applicability were assessed using the PROBAST + AI framework, with a focus on discrimination, calibration, and validation strategies (PROSPERO; registration number [CRD420251004644]). Of 673 records screened, 34 studies were included (21 unique datasets and 13 UCI-derived publications), encompassing 21,267 patients with a recurrence rate of 7.8%. Most were developed in Asian cohorts (17 of 21 datasets) and were structured clinical/tabular variables (82.4%), including demographic, clinical, laboratory, and pathological data, whereas the remaining models incorporated multimodal inputs such as imaging-derived or radiomic features. Notably, nearly one quarter of included studies (13 of 34, 38%) represented reanalysis of a single dataset. Discrimination was reported in 22 of 34 studies (64.7%) (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUC] 0.67-1.00), though only 10 studies assessed calibration, none with standardized metrics. The PROBAST + AI assessment revealed high overall quality concerns in 26 of 34 (76.5%) development studies due to reliance on single-center cohorts, inadequate handling of missing data, and absence of external validation. Only 6 of 34 included studies (17.6%) were judged to have low overall quality concern, whereas 17 of 34 (50.0%) were rated as having low applicability concern. AI models for predicting DTC recurrence show promising discriminatory performance but have substantial methodological shortcomings in development, and a lack of calibration and external validation necessary for clinical use. title: From task-specific networks to foundation models in diabetes care: a critical review of opportunities, evaluation gaps, and safety frontiers.

abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] Artificial intelligence in diabetes care has historically relied on task-specific supervised learning, such as bespoke networks for retinopathy grading, kidney disease prediction, and glucose forecasting. The emergence of foundation models (FMs: large models pretrained on broad data, typically with self-supervision, and adapted to many downstream tasks) is displacing this paradigm across diabetes-relevant modalities: ophthalmic models such as RETFound, pretrained on 1.6 million retinal photographs, have been reported to outperform task-specific networks on retinopathy grading and systemic disease prediction, especially when labeled data are scarce; transformer-based time-series models are replacing long short-term memory (LSTM) pipelines for continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) forecasting; clinical large language models (LLMs) such as Med-PaLM and GPT-4 attain expert-level scores on medical question-answering benchmarks; and generative models supply synthetic CGM and electronic health record (EHR) data. This review provides a critical, modality-organized synthesis of this transition. We (i) formalize a three-era taxonomy: rule-based risk scores (era I), task-specific deep learning (era II, 2016-2020), and foundation models (era III, from 2021), and map the diabetes literature onto it; (ii) survey foundation-model architectures, pretraining objectives, and adaptation strategies across retinal imaging, CGM, longitudinal EHR, and multimodal data; (iii) expose an evaluation crisis: benchmark contamination of LLM medical evaluations, a near-universal absence in the literature we reviewed of external and prospective validation for retinal and CGM foundation models, miscalibration under dataset shift, and, to our knowledge and within the reviewed literature (January 2016-December 2025; negative findings are time-sensitive), the absence of any randomized evaluation of a foundation model in a diabetes workflow; and (iv) analyze safety risks: hallucinated insulin-dosing advice, automation bias, inherited algorithmic inequity, and privacy exposure during adaptation. We conclude that the decisive open problem is no longer representation learning but grounded, calibrated, causally informed deployment, requiring contamination-resistant evaluation, prospective trials, and hybrid architectures coupling foundation-model representations with treatment-effect estimation.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in artificial intelligence] 糖尿病诊疗中的人工智能历来依赖针对特定任务的监督学习，例如用于视网膜病变分级、肾病预测和血糖预测的专用网络。基础模型（foundation models，FMs：在广泛数据上预训练、通常采用自监督方式、并可适配多种下游任务的大型模型）的出现，正在糖尿病相关的各类模态中取代这一范式：眼科模型如 RETFound（在160万张视网膜照片上预训练）据报道在视网膜病变分级和全身性疾病预测方面优于针对特定任务的网络，尤其是在标注数据稀缺时；基于 Transformer 的时间序列模型正在取代长短期记忆（LSTM）流程用于持续葡萄糖监测（CGM）预测；Med-PaLM 和 GPT-4 等临床大语言模型（LLMs）在医学问答基准上取得专家级分数；生成模型可提供合成的 CGM 和电子健康记录（EHR）数据。本综述按模态组织，对这一转变进行批判性综合。我们（i）提出三个时代的分类框架：基于规则的风险评分（第一时代）、针对特定任务的深度学习（第二时代，2016–2020年）和基础模型（第三时代，2021年起），并将糖尿病文献对应到该框架中；（ii）综述视网膜成像、CGM、纵向 EHR 和多模态数据中的基础模型架构、预训练目标和适配策略；（iii）揭示评估危机：LLM 医学评估存在基准污染；在我们所综述的文献中，视网膜和 CGM 基础模型几乎普遍缺乏外部验证和前瞻性验证；数据集偏移下存在校准失准；并且据我们所知，在所综述的文献范围内（2016年1月至2025年12月；阴性发现具有时效性），尚无任何针对糖尿病工作流程中基础模型的随机化评估；以及（iv）分析安全风险：幻觉性的胰岛素剂量建议、自动化偏倚、继承而来的算法不公平，以及适配过程中的隐私暴露。我们的结论是，决定性的未解难题已不再是表征学习，而是有依据、经校准、具因果信息的部署，这需要抗污染的评估、前瞻性试验，以及将基础模型表征与治疗效应估计相结合的混合架构。

abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) prediction from histology aims to infer spatially resolved gene expression profiles directly from tissue images. This is a challenging problem that is currently often addressed with complicated model architectures, additional inputs, and complicated training procedures, while remaining limited to fixed, small gene panels. This raises a natural question: Is there an efficient method for large-panel ST prediction? Here, we present GeneFlow, a simpler yet effective framework for large-scale spatial gene expression prediction that unifies flow-matching generative modeling with structured multimodal fusion. Specifically, GeneFlow first encodes both histological morphology and cross-gene interactions in spatial spots through histology and gene tokenizers. The model directly predicts spatial gene expression, rather than an intermediate velocity field, while being trained with a velocity-based flow-matching objective. We show that, even without relying on heavy generative pipelines, GeneFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple ST benchmarks, with up to 56.8% gains in 1,000-gene prediction. Extensive experiments further show that GeneFlow produces biologically meaningful spot profiles while reducing computational cost by orders of magnitude, thereby improving efficiency and scalability, particularly in clinical settings. We believe GeneFlow provides an opportunity for leveraging widely available histology images for downstream biological discovery. Code is available at: https://github.com/ZZhangsm/GeneFlow

abstract: [Methodist DeBakey cardiovascular journal] Valvular heart disease (VHD) affects a substantial proportion of the population and remains a major cause of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality worldwide. Despite advances in surgical and transcatheter therapies, important challenges persist. VHD remains underdiagnosed, assessment of disease severity is often variable, and the optimal timing of intervention continues to evolve. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising tool across the spectrum of VHD care. AI-based electrocardiogram analysis can identify both existing and future VHD, while AI-guided point-of-care ultrasound extends screening to nonspecialist settings. Across multimodality imaging, machine learning (ML) and deep learning algorithms enable automated, reproducible assessment of VHD. In echocardiography, AI supports grading of disease severity across the main valvular lesions, including Doppler interpretation and automated report generation. AI-enhanced cardiac magnetic resonance facilitates automated assessment of ventricular remodeling and myocardial fibrosis, while AI-assisted cardiac computed tomography improves procedural planning for transcatheter interventions. In parallel, ML has identified distinct patient phenotypes in multiple valvular lesions with differing clinical trajectories and responses to intervention. This review summarizes current applications of AI in detection, multimodality imaging, and potential clinical decision support for VHD and discusses opportunities and challenges for integration into routine practice.

abstract: [Computational biology and chemistry] The increasing complexity of tumor heterogeneity and variable therapeutic response has intensified the need for accurate personalized drug response prediction in oncology. Traditional trial-and-error chemotherapy strategies often result in suboptimal outcomes, toxicity, and delayed therapeutic adjustments. Rapid advances in multi-omics technologies, artificial intelligence (AI) and digital twin modeling have significantly reshaped computational oncology research. This survey systematically reviews peer-reviewed research and review articles published from 2021 onward that investigate emerging computational paradigms integrating digital twins and multi-omics AI for drug response prediction. The foundational concepts in digital twin oncology, multi-omics profiling and AI-driven precision medicine are outlined initially. The existing approaches are categorized into four major paradigms such as omics-driven machine learning models, deep learning based multimodal architectures, mechanistic digital twin simulation frameworks and hybrid digital twin AI systems enabling adaptive therapy optimization. The multi-omics data integration strategies, including early, intermediate, late, network-based and graph/pathway-based fusion techniques. The survey synthesizes recent developments in drug sensitivity prediction, immunotherapy response modeling, tumor evolution forecasting and virtual clinical trials, while critically analyzing challenges related to data heterogeneity, interpretability, generalization, privacy, regulatory compliance and ethical considerations. Finally, future directions are highlighted such as real-time adaptive digital twins, federated learning, explainable AI and regulatory ready clinical deployment frameworks. Overall, this review provides a structured taxonomy, comparative analysis and research roadmap for advancing integrated digital twin and multi omics AI systems toward clinically actionable precision oncology.

abstract: [BMC cancer] Lymphovascular space invasion (LVSI) is a critical prognostic factor guiding adjuvant therapy in early-stage cervical cancer, yet its preoperative assessment is often limited by the spatial resolution of standard MRI. This study aimed to investigate the value of a deep learning-based 3D super-resolution (SR) MRI radiomics model in predicting LVSI and to evaluate how SR reconstruction impacts image quality and radiomic feature robustness. This retrospective study included 117 patients with early-stage cervical cancer (training cohort: n = 81; validation cohort: n = 36). A 3D Super-Resolution Generative Adversarial Network (SRGAN) reconstructed T2-SPAIR and DWI sequences into super-resolution images (SRI) with a 4× upsampling factor. Radiomic features were extracted, and an SRI-based multimodal fusion model was developed and systematically compared with original image (OI)-based and clinical models using the Area Under the Curve (AUC) and Decision Curve Analysis (DCA). SR reconstruction significantly improved the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) for both DWI (P = 0.012) and T2-SPAIR (P = 0.030). For DWI, SRI preserved intratumoral texture heterogeneity, leading to improved diagnostic performance (Validation AUC: SRI-DWI 0.864 vs. OI-DWI 0.727, P = 0.041). The final SRI-Fusion model achieved the highest diagnostic accuracy (Validation AUC: 0.934), significantly outperforming the OI-Fusion model (AUC: 0.828, P = 0.044) and the clinical model (AUC: 0.626, P = 0.012). SRGAN-based reconstruction effectively improves MRI quality and feature robustness, particularly in DWI. The SRI-based multimodal radiomics model demonstrates superior predictive performance for LVSI in early-stage cervical cancer compared to conventional imaging and clinical models.
zh_abstract: [BMC cancer] 淋巴血管间隙浸润（LVSI）是指导早期宫颈癌辅助治疗的重要预后因素，但其术前评估常受限于标准 MRI 的空间分辨率。本研究旨在探讨基于深度学习的三维超分辨率（SR）MRI 影像组学模型预测 LVSI 的价值，并评估 SR 重建对图像质量和影像组学特征稳健性的影响。这项回顾性研究纳入 117 例早期宫颈癌患者（训练队列：n = 81；验证队列：n = 36）。采用三维超分辨率生成对抗网络（SRGAN）以 4 倍上采样因子将 T2-SPAIR 和 DWI 序列重建为超分辨率图像（SRI）。提取影像组学特征，构建基于 SRI 的多模态融合模型，并以曲线下面积（AUC）和决策曲线分析（DCA）与基于原始图像（OI）的模型及临床模型进行系统比较。SR 重建显著提高了 DWI（P = 0.012）和 T2-SPAIR（P = 0.030）的信噪比（SNR）。对于 DWI，SRI 保留了肿瘤内部纹理异质性，从而提高了诊断性能（验证集 AUC：SRI-DWI 0.864 vs. OI-DWI 0.727，P = 0.041）。最终的 SRI 融合模型诊断准确性最高（验证集 AUC：0.934），显著优于 OI 融合模型（AUC：0.828，P = 0.044）和临床模型（AUC：0.626，P = 0.012）。基于 SRGAN 的重建可有效改善 MRI 图像质量和特征稳健性，尤其是 DWI。与传统影像及临床模型相比，基于 SRI 的多模态影像组学模型对早期宫颈癌 LVSI 具有更优的预测性能。

abstract: [BMC medical education] General practitioners face high complexity in clinical decision-making. Large language models (LLMs) may support clinical reasoning, but their impact on decision-making processes and postgraduate medical training remains unclear. This qualitative study aims to explore General Practice (GP) trainee's use of LLMs in clinical reasoning and their educational needs. GP trainees were recruited and interviewed with semi-structured interview-guide. Interviews were transcribed verbatim and analysed qualitatively. Seventeen GP trainees participated (mean interview duration: 38 min; range: 21-63 min). AI was perceived as a tool to augment and accelerate clinical decision-making, while potential risks of deskilling were identified. Participants reported a lack of structured AI education and expressed a need for its integration into postgraduate training. Participants perceived AI primarily as a supportive tool that can complement clinical reasoning and improve access to medical knowledge. At the same time, they identified potential risks, including overreliance on AI-generated information and possible effects on the development of clinical expertise. These findings suggest that postgraduate medical training should address AI-related competencies, including critical appraisal, ethical responsibility and appropriate integration of AI into clinical decision-making. AI is already part of clinical practice among GP trainees, offering opportunities to support learning and clinical reasoning while raising concerns about overreliance and critical appraisal. Postgraduate medical training in GP should therefore incorporate structured AI competencies to ensure responsible, reflective and patient-centered use of AI.
zh_abstract: [BMC medical education] 全科医生在临床决策中面临高度复杂性。大语言模型（LLM）可能有助于临床推理，但其对决策过程和毕业后医学培训的影响尚不明确。这项定性研究旨在探讨全科（GP）培训医生在临床推理中使用 LLM 的情况及其教育需求。招募 GP 培训医生，采用半结构化访谈提纲进行访谈。访谈内容逐字转录并进行定性分析。共 17 名 GP 培训医生参与（平均访谈时长：38 分钟；范围：21–63 分钟）。AI 被认为是增强和加速临床决策的工具，同时也识别出技能退化的潜在风险。参与者表示缺乏系统的 AI 教育，并希望将其纳入毕业后培训。参与者主要将 AI 视为可补充临床推理并改善医学知识获取的辅助工具。同时，他们也指出了潜在风险，包括过度依赖 AI 生成的信息以及对临床专业能力发展的可能影响。这些发现提示，毕业后医学培训应涵盖与 AI 相关的能力，包括批判性评价、伦理责任以及将 AI 恰当地融入临床决策。AI 已成为 GP 培训医生临床实践的一部分，为支持学习和临床推理提供了机会，同时也引发了对过度依赖和批判性评价的担忧。因此，全科毕业后医学培训应纳入系统的 AI 能力培养，以确保负责任、反思性且以患者为中心地使用 AI。

title: Classification Performance of a Deep Learning Algorithm for Common Skin Lesions in the Emergency Department: A Multicenter Preliminary Validation Study.
zh_title: 急诊常见皮肤病变深度学习算法的多中心初步外部验证
summary: 基于ResNet-50的算法在独立机构100张图像上外部验证，并探索算法预分类是否改变9名医务人员的分类表现。
key_points: 训练集为4815例患者6000张图像
外部验证仅100张图像
含人机对照的重读设计

abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Background/Objectives: Initial classification of skin lesions in the emergency department (ED) is difficult when dermatology consultations are limited. This study externally validated a deep learning (DL) algorithm for classifying three common ED skin lesions and explored whether algorithmic pre-classification was associated with changes in the classification performance of medical staff. Methods: A ResNet-50-based algorithm was developed using 6000 clinical images from 4815 patients. For external validation, 100 images from an independent institution were classified by the algorithm and nine medical staff members (three emergency medicine specialists, three residents, and three physician assistant [PA] nurses). Fifteen days later, the staff reclassified the same randomly reordered images with the algorithmic pre-classification provided. Results: In external validation, the algorithm showed an overall accuracy of 0.96 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.90-0.99), lesion-specific balanced accuracies of 0.95-0.96, and a macro-average area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.98 (95% CI, 0.95-1.00). Unassisted, the three PA nurses differed significantly from the algorithm for urticaria and herpes zoster (all p < 0.01, McNemar's exact test). After receiving algorithmic assistance, all medical staff showed a balanced accuracy of 0.97 or higher for all three lesions. In the mixed-effects model, assistance was associated with higher odds of correct classification (odds ratio 25.9, 95% CI 11.7-57.2), and inter-rater agreement (Fleiss' κ) increased from 0.70 to 0.97. Conclusions: The algorithm demonstrated high classification performance on independent external validation, and algorithmic assistance was associated with improved classification performance, with the largest absolute gains among medical staff with lower unassisted accuracy. As these findings are exploratory, they should be confirmed in randomized prospective studies.
zh_abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] 【背景/目的】在皮肤科会诊资源有限时，急诊科（ED）对皮肤病变进行初步分类较为困难。本研究对一种用于分类三种常见急诊皮肤病变的深度学习（DL）算法进行了外部验证，并探讨算法预分类是否与医务人员分类表现的变化相关。【方法】基于来自4815例患者的6000张临床图像，开发了一种基于ResNet-50的算法。为进行外部验证，由该算法及九名医务人员（三名急诊医学专科医师、三名住院医师和三名医师助理[PA]护士）对来自一家独立机构的100张图像进行分类。15天后，医务人员在提供算法预分类结果的情况下，对随机重新排序的同一批图像重新分类。【结果】在外部验证中，该算法的总体准确率为0.96（95%置信区间[CI]，0.90-0.99），各病变的平衡准确率为0.95-0.96，宏平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积为0.98（95% CI，0.95-1.00）。在无辅助情况下，三名PA护士在荨麻疹和带状疱疹的分类上与算法存在显著差异（均p < 0.01，McNemar精确检验）。在获得算法辅助后，所有医务人员对三种病变的平衡准确率均达到0.97或更高。在混合效应模型中，辅助与更高的正确分类几率相关（比值比25.9，95% CI 11.7-57.2），评估者间一致性（Fleiss' κ）由0.70提高至0.97。【结论】该算法在独立外部验证中表现出较高的分类性能，算法辅助与分类表现的改善相关，其中无辅助准确率较低的医务人员绝对提升最大。由于这些结果属于探索性发现，应通过随机前瞻性研究加以证实。

title: No Mastery without the Machine — Medical Education in the Age of Clinical AI
zh_title: 没有机器就没有精通：临床AI时代的医学教育
summary: NEJM AI观点文章认为，AI不应只被视为医学教育的威胁，教育重点应从记忆事实转向质询机器推理、识别失效模式及判断何时需人工干预。
key_points: 回应AI削弱训练者认知挣扎、影响临床判断的担忧
医学精通可能转向对智能系统的编排、监督与校准性依赖
教育应聚焦质询机器推理并识别失效模式
reason: 观点类文章，无新数据，属增量档；医学教育治理话题略有关联
abstract: AbstractAI is often framed as a threat to medical education owing to concerns it may diminish the cognitive struggle through which trainees traditionally develop clinical judgment - a legitimate but incomplete concern. Medicine has never been defined by unaided human cognition; it has been defined by the obligation to use the best available tools in the service of patients. As AI systems increasingly extend not only clinicians' perception, but also their reasoning, medical mastery may shift from memorization and independent synthesis toward the orchestration, supervision, and calibrated deference to intelligent systems. The task for medical education is therefore not to preserve cognitive struggle for its own sake, but to refocus it from recalling facts to interrogating machine reasoning, detecting failure modes, and knowing when human intervention improves care versus when it merely interrupts a better system.
zh_abstract: 摘要：人们常将人工智能（AI）视为医学教育的威胁，原因是担心它可能削弱学员传统上借以培养临床判断力的认知磨砺——这种担忧合理，但并不全面。医学从来不是由不借助工具的人类认知所定义的；它是由为患者利益而使用现有最佳工具的义务所定义的。随着AI系统不仅日益延伸临床医生的感知能力，也延伸其推理能力，医学上的精通可能会从记忆和独立综合，转向对智能系统的统筹、监督以及经过校准的服从。因此，医学教育的任务并不是为了保留认知磨砺而保留它，而是将其重心从回忆事实转向质询机器推理、识别失效模式，并判断何时人为干预能改善医疗，何时只是打断了一个更优的系统。

title: Multi-Reference Evaluation of Deep Learning Tumour Segmentation in Multi-Sequence Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma MRI.
zh_title: 鼻咽癌多序列MRI深度学习分割的多参考标准评估
summary: 在277例公开数据上用nnU-Net评估，量化参考掩膜选择对Dice报告结果的影响，并与放射科医生间分歧比较。
key_points: 使用277例公开多序列MRI数据
30例有两名放射科医生标注
nnU-Net对每种参考分别评分
reason: 评估方法学有新意，但数据规模有限、无外部验证
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Deep learning segmentation of nasopharyngeal carcinoma is usually reported as one Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) against one reference mask, although multi-sequence MRI is often delineated separately on each sequence. We aimed to quantify how far the choice of reference changes reported performance, and to compare this with the disagreement between radiologists. Methods: We analysed a public dataset of 277 patient records with separately delineated T1-weighted, T2-weighted and contrast-enhanced T1-weighted MRI, 30 of whom were annotated by two radiologists. Tumour volumes were compared without registration. Spatial agreement was measured after rigid registration, with the loss from transferring masks between acquisition grids estimated separately. nnU-Net models were scored against every reference, including the second radiologist's, in 102 held-out patient records. Results: Without registration, the sequence effect on tumour volume was 10.9%, against a reader effect of 5.7% (ratio 1.9, 95% CI 1.40 to 2.49). After rigid registration, per-sequence references agreed at a median DSC of 0.783, against 0.898 between radiologists; in the double-annotated patient records, the paired gap narrowed only from 0.129 to 0.083 (95% CI 0.063 to 0.111) when grid transfer was matched. One fixed set of predictions scored 0.726, 0.685 and 0.673, depending only on the reference (median per-patient reference spread 0.075), and switching the reference sequence moved scores 2.7 to 3.6 times as much as switching the radiologist. Conclusions: Part of the cross-sequence difference is a difference in what each sequence makes visible rather than annotation error, so a single-reference DSC on multi-sequence data depends on a rarely stated choice. Performance should be reported against every available reference and read against measured inter-reader agreement.
zh_abstract: 【背景/目的】鼻咽癌的深度学习分割结果通常仅以针对单一参考掩膜的一个 Dice 相似系数（DSC）报告，尽管多序列 MRI 往往在每个序列上分别勾画。我们旨在量化参考标准的选择在多大程度上改变所报告的性能，并将其与放射科医师之间的分歧进行比较。【方法】我们分析了一个公开数据集，包含 277 份患者记录，其 T1 加权、T2 加权和增强 T1 加权 MRI 均经分别勾画，其中 30 例由两名放射科医师分别标注。肿瘤体积的比较未经配准。空间一致性在刚性配准后测量，并单独估计掩膜在采集网格之间转换所造成的损失。在 102 份留出的患者记录中，针对每一种参考（包括第二名放射科医师的参考）对 nnU-Net 模型进行评分。【结果】未经配准时，序列对肿瘤体积的影响为 10.9%，而读者间影响为 5.7%（比值 1.9，95% CI 1.40 至 2.49）。刚性配准后，各序列参考之间一致性的 DSC 中位数为 0.783，而放射科医师之间为 0.898；在双人标注的患者记录中，当匹配网格转换后，配对差距仅从 0.129 缩小至 0.083（95% CI 0.063 至 0.111）。同一组固定预测结果，仅因参考不同，得分分别为 0.726、0.685 和 0.673（每例患者参考间差异中位数为 0.075），更换参考序列所引起的得分变化是更换放射科医师的 2.7 至 3.6 倍。【结论】跨序列差异中有一部分是各序列所能显示内容的不同，而非标注误差，因此多序列数据上基于单一参考的 DSC 取决于一个很少被说明的选择。性能应针对所有可用参考进行报告，并结合实测的读者间一致性来解读。

title: Automated Detection of Abnormal Pediatric Electroencephalograms Using Machine Learning: Retrospective Study.

summary: 在埃森大学医院儿童脑电数据上，比较梯度提升模型与基于图像的CNN深度学习模型识别异常脑电的表现，深度学习模型敏感性更高。

abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used in medicine as a technique for the assessment of several brain-related pathologies. However, EEG interpretation requires specialized expertise and remains a labor-intensive task, particularly for prolonged recordings in intensive care, where timely expert review is often challenging. The aim of this study is to address this problem by using AI methods to automate EEG interpretation and compare the performance of different modeling approaches. A gradient boosting-based model, inspired by the work of Albaqami et al, was implemented and compared to deep learning (DL)-based models using convolutional neural networks to classify images generated from raw EEG signals. The models were trained and tested on pediatric EEGs acquired at the University Hospital in Essen. The DL model showed higher observed sensitivity (78.3%) and F1-score (80%) compared to the gradient boosting model (sensitivity: 65.2%; F1-score: 73.8%), indicating improved detection of abnormal EEGs. However, the gradient boosting approach achieved higher specificity (93% vs 89.6%), suggesting a stronger ability to recognize normal EEGs. Overall, both methods yielded promising results, with classification accuracies reaching up to 85.3%. Both approaches show potential for automated EEG interpretation. Future improvements, including larger and more diverse datasets, refined DL architectures, and integration of explainable AI techniques, could further enhance performance.
zh_abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] 脑电图（EEG）作为评估多种脑相关疾病的技术，在医学中被广泛使用。然而，EEG判读需要专业知识，仍是一项劳动密集型任务，尤其是重症监护中的长时程记录，及时的专家审阅往往具有挑战性。本研究旨在通过使用AI方法实现EEG判读自动化并比较不同建模方法的性能来解决这一问题。我们实现了一个受Albaqami等工作启发的基于梯度提升的模型，并与使用卷积神经网络对由原始EEG信号生成的图像进行分类的深度学习（DL）模型进行比较。模型在埃森大学医院采集的儿科EEG上进行训练和测试。与梯度提升模型（敏感性：65.2%；F1分数：73.8%）相比，DL模型显示出更高的观察敏感性（78.3%）和F1分数（80%），表明其对异常EEG的检出能力更好。然而，梯度提升方法获得了更高的特异性（93% 对 89.6%），提示其识别正常EEG的能力更强。总体而言，两种方法均取得了有前景的结果，分类准确率最高达85.3%。两种方法均显示出用于EEG自动判读的潜力。未来的改进，包括更大且更多样化的数据集、优化的DL架构以及整合可解释AI技术，可能进一步提升性能。

title: Current Applications of Artificial Intelligence in Surgical Planning for Craniosynostosis: A Scoping Review.
zh_title: 颅缝早闭手术规划中AI应用的范围综述
summary: 按PRISMA-ScR纳入11项研究，梳理AI在颅缝早闭诊断、手术规划与结局预测中的应用。

abstract: [ANZ journal of surgery] Craniosynostosis, the premature fusion of cranial sutures, can cause abnormal skull shapes, neurological issues and aesthetic concerns. Surgical correction is standard, but planning is complex and operator-dependent. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers the potential to enhance diagnosis, optimise planning and predict postoperative outcomes. A scoping review following PRISMA-ScR guidelines identified 11 studies involving paediatric patients with craniosynostosis. AI methods included unsupervised machine learning, convolutional neural networks, finite element models and variational autoencoders. Applications encompassed cranial severity scoring, phenotype classification, preoperative surgical simulation, intraoperative guidance and outcome prediction. AI-derived metrics correlated strongly with expert assessments, facilitated patient-specific planning and predicted postoperative aesthetics. AI is a transformative adjunct in craniosynostosis surgery. Clinically, it improves diagnostic accuracy, supports personalised surgical planning and guides intraoperative decision-making. Some studies show AI can contribute to better functional and aesthetic outcomes, showing great promise in the paediatric surgical field. Although AI does not replace clinical expertise, it enhances precision and reproducibility. Future research should prioritise prospective validation, integration into surgical workflows and development of interpretable, surgeon-friendly AI tools to maximise clinical benefit.
zh_abstract: [ANZ journal of surgery] 颅缝早闭是指颅缝过早融合，可导致颅骨形态异常、神经系统问题及外观方面的困扰。手术矫正是标准治疗，但手术规划复杂且依赖术者。人工智能（AI）有望改善诊断、优化规划并预测术后结局。本研究按照 PRISMA-ScR 指南进行范围综述，共纳入 11 项涉及颅缝早闭儿科患者的研究。所采用的 AI 方法包括无监督机器学习、卷积神经网络、有限元模型和变分自编码器。应用范围涵盖颅骨严重程度评分、表型分类、术前手术模拟、术中引导及结局预测。AI 衍生的指标与专家评估高度相关，有助于制定患者个体化的手术规划，并可预测术后外观。AI 是颅缝早闭手术中具有变革意义的辅助手段。在临床上，它可提高诊断准确性，支持个体化手术规划，并指导术中决策。部分研究显示，AI 有助于获得更好的功能和外观结局，在儿科外科领域显示出巨大前景。尽管 AI 不能取代临床专业经验，但它可提高精确性和可重复性。未来研究应优先开展前瞻性验证、将其整合入手术工作流程，并开发可解释、便于外科医生使用的 AI 工具，以最大化临床获益。

title: Design and Simulation of an AI-Powered Artificial Pancreas System With Personalized Glucose Sensing and Insulin Delivery.

边缘端规则安全层含胰岛素在体量与低血糖暂停

abstract: [Artificial organs] Achieving tight glycemic control in Type 1 diabetes is challenged by non-linear metabolic dynamics and insulin-stacking risk. Artificial intelligence models offer improved personalization, but their opacity raises safety concerns, particularly for basal insulin dosing, which is often treated as static in existing decision-support systems. We propose a hybrid closed-loop system combining a data-driven LightGBM regressor for basal dose prediction, trained on the T1D-UOM dataset, with a physiologically grounded, rule-based safety layer at the edge. Basal insulin is predicted from cyclical time encoding and glucose rate-of-change; bolus dosing follows carbohydrate intake and correction requirements. A time-bounded insulin-on-board model, an uncertainty-adaptive post-bolus damping factor, and a predictive low-glucose-suspend rule reproducing the Tandem Basal-IQ protocol together suspend or reduce delivery when residual insulin is high or hypoglycemia is projected. The system was evaluated in silico over 60 continuous days under shadow-mode replay and closed-loop reduced-order simulation, including an ablation with bolus delivery suppressed. Under chronological, within-subject validation, the offline basal estimator achieved R 2 = 0.68 and MAE = 0.21 U; under strict leave-one-subject-out validation on the same real cohort, performance did not generalize to unseen subjects ( R 2 = - 0.49 , MAE = 0.49 U). The hybrid controller maintained Time-in-Range at 62.8% within the reduced-order closed-loop simulation, with no violations of the insulin-on-board suspension or damping rules; suppressing bolus delivery in an ablation within this simulation dropped Time-in-Range to 26.1%, indicating that, within the reduced-order model, bolus delivery is a determinant of simulated glycemic outcome. The proposed architecture demonstrates a safety-audited template for combining machine-learning basal prediction with clinically grounded dosing rules. Validation on real outcome data and physical hardware is identified as the next steps toward clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Artificial organs] 1型糖尿病的严格血糖控制面临非线性代谢动力学和胰岛素叠加风险的挑战。人工智能模型可提供更好的个体化，但其不透明性引发了安全性担忧，尤其是基础胰岛素给药，而现有决策支持系统常将其视为静态。我们提出一种混合闭环系统，将在T1D-UOM数据集上训练的、用于基础剂量预测的数据驱动LightGBM回归器，与位于边缘端的、基于生理学的规则型安全层相结合。基础胰岛素根据周期性时间编码和血糖变化率进行预测；大剂量给药则依据碳水化合物摄入量和校正需求。限定时间的体内胰岛素（insulin-on-board）模型、不确定性自适应的餐后大剂量衰减因子，以及复现Tandem Basal-IQ方案的预测性低血糖暂停规则，共同作用，在残余胰岛素较高或预计发生低血糖时暂停或减少给药。该系统在影子模式回放和闭环降阶模拟下进行了为期60个连续日的计算机模拟评估，包括抑制大剂量给药的消融实验。在按时间顺序的受试者内验证中，离线基础胰岛素估计器的R2 = 0.68，MAE = 0.21 U；在同一真实队列上进行严格的留一受试者验证时，性能无法推广至未见过的受试者（R2 = -0.49，MAE = 0.49 U）。在降阶闭环模拟中，混合控制器将目标范围内时间维持在62.8%，且未违反体内胰岛素暂停或衰减规则；在该模拟中的消融实验里，抑制大剂量给药使目标范围内时间降至26.1%，表明在该降阶模型内，大剂量给药是模拟血糖结局的决定因素。所提出的架构展示了一种经安全审计的模板，可将机器学习基础胰岛素预测与基于临床的给药规则相结合。基于真实结局数据和实体硬件的验证被确定为迈向临床转化的下一步。

title: CT-based machine learning and multimodal prediction in acute pancreatitis: a narrative review.
zh_title: 急性胰腺炎的CT机器学习与多模态预测：叙述性综述
summary: 叙述性综述CT影像组学、深度学习及临床-影像模型在急性胰腺炎严重程度和不良结局预测中的表现。

重症预测内部AUC 0.852–0.894
外部测试AUC 0.887–0.916，非系统性综合

abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Acute pancreatitis (AP) has a highly variable clinical course. This narrative review focuses on computed tomography (CT) radiomics, deep learning and clinical-imaging models for severity and adverse-outcome prediction, with clinical-only models as context. A targeted PubMed search checked on 16 October 2026, with a publication cutoff of 14 October 2026, retrieved 80 unique records; ten CT-informed exemplars and eight clinical-context studies were selected for detailed comparison. This is a representative, non-exhaustive synthesis. For severe AP (SAP) prediction, reported same-center internal or temporal areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) ranged from 0.852 to 0.894, and reported external-test AUCs from 0.887 to 0.916; one validation cohort of unconfirmed independence had an AUC of 0.920. These descriptive ranges do not establish model superiority or characterize all retrieved studies. CT protocols and input timing, endpoint definitions, sampling and validation designs varied. Predominantly retrospective evidence, uncertain prediction landmarks, incomplete calibration and threshold reporting, and limited prospective impact assessment constrain translation. Feature explanations describe model associations rather than causal intervention targets. Imaging artificial intelligence (AI) remains an adjunct to clinical assessment; independent validation, calibration, decision-curve appraisal and prospective workflow/outcome evaluation are needed before clinical-pathway integration.
zh_abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] 急性胰腺炎（AP）的临床病程差异很大。本叙述性综述聚焦于用于预测严重程度和不良结局的计算机断层扫描（CT）影像组学、深度学习及临床-影像模型，并以仅基于临床的模型作为背景参照。于2026年10月16日核查的针对性PubMed检索（发表截止日期为2026年10月14日）共检索到80条不重复记录；选取10项基于CT的代表性研究和8项临床背景研究进行详细比较。本文为具有代表性但非穷尽的综合分析。对于重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）的预测，报告的同中心内部或时间验证的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为0.852至0.894，外部测试AUC为0.887至0.916；另有一个独立性未经证实的验证队列AUC为0.920。这些描述性范围并不能确立模型的优越性，也不能代表所有检索到的研究。CT扫描方案和输入时间点、终点定义、抽样及验证设计各不相同。证据以回顾性为主、预测时间节点不明确、校准和阈值报告不完整，以及前瞻性影响评估有限，这些因素制约了研究成果的转化。特征解释所描述的是模型关联，而非可干预的因果靶点。影像人工智能（AI）仍然只是临床评估的辅助手段；在纳入临床路径之前，需要进行独立验证、校准、决策曲线评估以及前瞻性的工作流程/结局评价。

title: Performance of a Large Language Model for Predicting Clinical and Radiographic Outcomes in Knee Osteoarthritis: Single-Center Prospective Observational Study.
zh_title: 大语言模型预测膝骨关节炎临床与影像结局：单中心前瞻研究
summary: 在128例膝骨关节炎患者中评估DeepSeek评估基线状态、预测6个月结局及多次运行可重复性，并与风湿科医生比较。
key_points: 前瞻队列，111例完成6个月随访
对比DeepSeek-V4-Flash与风湿科医生
评估基线评估、预测及运行间可重复性
reason: 单中心小样本，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] Large language models (LLMs) can extract information from unstructured clinical text, but it remains unclear whether their ability to assess current status translates into reliable predictions of longitudinal outcomes. This study aimed to evaluate DeepSeek's ability to assess baseline clinical and radiographic status in knee osteoarthritis (KOA), its performance in predicting 6-month outcomes, and its interrun reproducibility. This study used a single-center, prospective observational cohort design to conduct a blinded, retrospective evaluation of the LLM. A total of 128 patients with primary KOA were enrolled, of whom 111 (86.7%) completed the 6-month follow-up and were included in the primary analysis. DeepSeek-V4-Flash and a rheumatologist independently assessed KOA diagnoses, baseline Western Ontario and McMaster Universities Osteoarthritis Index (WOMAC) scores, and Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) grading based on the same standardized interview records and imaging reports and predicted 6-month outcomes. The LLM was run independently 3 times. The actual outcomes determined by another senior physician served as the reference, and the results were compared with the physician's predictions and the persistence model. The LLM showed high baseline diagnostic agreement with the physician (105/111, 94.6%) and good agreement on the WOMAC and KL, but 6-month predictions (WOMAC mean absolute error=5.92-6.58; KL exact agreement=74/111, 66.7%-76/111, 68.5%) were worse than those of the physician comparator (mean absolute error=3.86; 96/111, 86.5%) and not superior to those of the persistence model (mean absolute error=5.43). Despite high interrun intraclass correlation coefficients (0.982 and 0.965), exact agreement between runs was poor (35/111, 31.5% and 7/111, 6.3%). The evaluated DeepSeek configuration may support structured baseline KOA assessment. However, its 6-month predictive accuracy and patient-level stability remain limited. Prognostic applications require evidence of added value over a persistence model.
zh_abstract: [JMIR medical informatics] 大语言模型（LLM）能够从非结构化临床文本中提取信息，但其评估当前状态的能力能否转化为对纵向结局的可靠预测仍不清楚。本研究旨在评估 DeepSeek 在膝骨关节炎（KOA）中评估基线临床和影像学状态的能力、其预测6个月结局的表现，以及其多次运行之间的可重复性。本研究采用单中心前瞻性观察性队列设计，对该 LLM 进行盲法回顾性评估。共纳入128例原发性 KOA 患者，其中111例（86.7%）完成6个月随访并纳入主要分析。DeepSeek-V4-Flash 与一名风湿科医生基于相同的标准化问诊记录和影像学报告，独立评估 KOA 诊断、基线西安大略和麦克马斯特大学骨关节炎指数（WOMAC）评分及 Kellgren-Lawrence（KL）分级，并预测6个月结局。该 LLM 独立运行3次。以另一名资深医生判定的实际结局作为参照，并将结果与医生的预测及持续性模型（persistence model）进行比较。LLM 与医生在基线诊断上的一致性较高（105/111，94.6%），在 WOMAC 和 KL 上的一致性良好，但其6个月预测（WOMAC 平均绝对误差=5.92-6.58；KL 完全一致=74/111，66.7%至76/111，68.5%）不及医生对照（平均绝对误差=3.86；96/111，86.5%），且并不优于持续性模型（平均绝对误差=5.43）。尽管多次运行之间的组内相关系数较高（0.982和0.965），但各次运行之间的完全一致性较差（35/111，31.5%和7/111，6.3%）。所评估的 DeepSeek 配置可能有助于结构化的 KOA 基线评估。然而，其6个月预测准确性和患者层面的稳定性仍然有限。预后应用需要提供相对于持续性模型具有附加价值的证据。

title: Inferring single-cell gene expression profiles from multicellular spatial transcriptomics data with st2sc
zh_title: st2sc：从多细胞空间转录组推断单细胞基因表达
summary: 提出端到端框架st2sc，用注意力梯度流追踪算法，从多细胞空间转录组数据中恢复单细胞表达谱。
key_points: 针对空间转录组分辨率受限问题
提出注意力梯度流追踪（AGFT）算法
需先识别单个细胞再估计基因表达
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要中证据有限
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables the quantitative measurement of gene expression within tissue sections but is currently limited in spatial resolution, as each spot aggregates signals from multiple cells. Recovering single-cell gene expression profiles from these multicellular measurements requires two steps: explicit identification of individual cells and accurate estimation of per-gene expression. While existing methods have demonstrated the feasibility of recovering single-cell expression profiles, accurately estimating gene-level expression for individual cells remains an important challenge. To address this challenge, we propose st2sc (Spatial Transcriptomics to Single-Cell), an end-to-end framework for inferring single-cell gene profiles from multicellular ST data. st2sc introduces a novel Attention Gradient Flow Tracking (AGFT) algorithm that extracts attention maps from a Vision-Gene Transformer to identify candidate cell instances without predefined background constraints. The detected instances are then used by a set of regressors trained under a multiple-instance, multiple-target regression setting to predict precise single-cell gene expression counts. Comprehensive evaluations on synthetic and Visium-like datasets demonstrate that st2sc significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in accurately segmenting cellular instances and predicting gene counts. The method can further resolve contested 2um bin in Visium HD. Application to human IPF lung showed the model can recover the subtype marker level analysis. This advancement further improves single-cell resolution analysis in spatial transcriptomics, facilitating more accurate downstream biological analyses.
zh_abstract: 空间转录组学（ST）能够对组织切片内的基因表达进行定量测量，但目前空间分辨率有限，因为每个点位会汇集来自多个细胞的信号。从这些多细胞测量中恢复单细胞基因表达谱需要两个步骤：显式识别单个细胞，以及准确估计每个基因的表达。尽管现有方法已证明恢复单细胞表达谱是可行的，但准确估计单个细胞的基因水平表达仍是一项重要挑战。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了st2sc（Spatial Transcriptomics to Single-Cell），这是一个从多细胞ST数据推断单细胞基因表达谱的端到端框架。st2sc引入了一种新颖的注意力梯度流追踪（Attention Gradient Flow Tracking，AGFT）算法，从视觉-基因Transformer（Vision-Gene Transformer）中提取注意力图，在无需预定义背景约束的情况下识别候选细胞实例。随后，检测到的实例被输入一组在多实例、多目标回归设定下训练的回归器，以预测精确的单细胞基因表达计数。在合成数据集和类Visium数据集上的综合评估表明，st2sc在准确分割细胞实例和预测基因计数方面显著优于最先进的方法。该方法还可进一步解析Visium HD中存在争议的2um bin。应用于人类特发性肺纤维化（IPF）肺组织显示，该模型能够恢复亚型标志物水平的分析。这一进展进一步提升了空间转录组学中的单细胞分辨率分析，有助于进行更准确的下游生物学分析。

title: Effect of Data Preprocessing Decisions on Sepsis-3 Labels in MIMIC-III and eICU-CRD: A Sensitivity Analysis
zh_title: 预处理决策对MIMIC-III与eICU脓毒症标签的影响
summary: 在固定队列上改变51种预处理设置，评估对Sepsis-3标签检出率的影响，旨在解释已发表检出率的巨大差异（预印本）。
key_points: MIMIC-III队列13,388例，eICU 94,782例
开发映射至OMOP的medalabel流水线
逐项改动51种预处理变体
reason: 规范的可复现性敏感性分析，样本大但为公开库预印本
abstract: Objective: Published Sepsis-3 detection rates range from 3.4 % to 65.2 % in MIMIC-III and from 9.8 % to 47.9 % in eICU-CRD. We tested whether data preprocessing decisions alone produce differences of this magnitude when data, cohort and sepsis definition are held fixed. Materials and Methods: Using the MIMIC-III and eICU-CRD databases we developed and applied a configurable pipeline (medalabel) that stepwise maps the databases into the OMOP Common Data Model, standardizes and cleans the data, and preprocesses them to compute Sepsis-3 labels. Each setting of the preprocessing represents one decision of published Sepsis-3 implementations, and settings can be freely combined. On fixed cohorts of first ICU stays (13,388 in MIMIC-III, 94,782 in eICU-CRD), we changed one setting of a reference configuration at a time (51 variants in five preprocessing domains) and compared detection rates and septic stays (Jaccard index) with the reference. We approximately reconstructed six published pipelines and combined the settings with the largest effects in pairs to test whether their effects add up. The time a value is measured can differ from the time it is documented and thus available for automated analysis. Beyond the usual retrospective view based on measurement time, the pipeline optionally combines both time points to simulate a real-time system. Results: The reference configuration labelled 31.5 % of ICU stays in MIMIC-III and 8.2 % in eICU-CRD as septic. Changing a single setting resulted in sepsis detection rates of 15.3-58.6 % in MIMIC-III and 4.6-17.2 % in eICU-CRD. The largest shifts from the reference, all in the same direction in both databases, came from the SOFA baseline, up to +27.1 percentage points (pp) in MIMIC-III and +9.0 pp in eICU-CRD, from disabling imputation (-16.3 and -2.5 pp), the temporal window (+12.6 and +5.3 pp) and aggregation (-10.1 and -0.8 pp); clinician-validated parameter sets had little effect (-4.8 and -1.1 pp). Even variants that changed the rate by less than 2 pp labelled partly different patients, with Jaccard indices as low as 0.67 in MIMIC-III and 0.56 in eICU-CRD (1 = identical septic stays). Reconstructions deviated from the published rates by 2-10 pp. Two settings applied together deviated from the sum of their single effects by 0.9-11.8 pp in MIMIC-III and by up to 4.9 pp in eICU-CRD. Simulating a real-time system lowered the MIMIC-III rate by 5.0 pp and delayed the label in 45 % of the stays that remained septic. Discus
zh_abstract:
【目的】已发表的 Sepsis-3 检出率在 MIMIC-III 中为 3.4% 至 65.2%，在 eICU-CRD 中为 9.8% 至 47.9%。我们检验了在数据、队列和脓毒症定义保持不变的情况下，仅数据预处理决策是否即可产生如此量级的差异。
【材料与方法】利用 MIMIC-III 和 eICU-CRD 数据库，我们开发并应用了一个可配置的流程（medalabel），该流程逐步将数据库映射到 OMOP 通用数据模型，对数据进行标准化和清洗，并进行预处理以计算 Sepsis-3 标签。预处理的每一项设置代表已发表的 Sepsis-3 实现中的一个决策，各设置可自由组合。在固定的首次 ICU 住院队列上（MIMIC-III 为 13,388 例，eICU-CRD 为 94,782 例），我们每次改变参考配置中的一项设置（涵盖五个预处理领域的 51 个变体），并将检出率和脓毒症住院（Jaccard 指数）与参考配置进行比较。我们大致重建了六个已发表的流程，并将影响最大的设置两两组合，以检验其效应是否可叠加。数值被测量的时间可能不同于其被记录、从而可用于自动分析的时间。除了基于测量时间的常规回顾性视角外，该流程还可选择结合这两个时间点来模拟实时系统。
【结果】参考配置将 MIMIC-III 中 31.5% 的 ICU 住院和 eICU-CRD 中 8.2% 的 ICU 住院标记为脓毒症。仅改变单项设置，MIMIC-III 的脓毒症检出率为 15.3–58.6%，eICU-CRD 为 4.6–17.2%。相对参考配置变化最大的因素（两个数据库中方向一致）为：SOFA 基线，MIMIC-III 中最高 +27.1 个百分点（pp），eICU-CRD 中为 +9.0 pp；停用插补（-16.3 和 -2.5 pp）；时间窗（+12.6 和 +5.3 pp）；以及聚合方式（-10.1 和 -0.8 pp）；经临床医生验证的参数集影响很小（-4.8 和 -1.1 pp）。即使检出率变化小于 2 pp 的变体，所标记的患者也部分不同，Jaccard 指数在 MIMIC-III 中低至 0.67，在 eICU-CRD 中低至 0.56（1 表示脓毒症住院完全相同）。重建的流程与已发表的检出率相差 2–10 pp。两项设置同时应用时，与其单项效应之和相比，在 MIMIC-III 中偏差 0.9–11.8 pp，在 eICU-CRD 中偏差最高达 4.9 pp。模拟实时系统使 MIMIC-III 的检出率降低 5.0 pp，并使仍为脓毒症的住院中 45% 的标签出现延迟。

title: AI-enabled drug repurposing in Alzheimer's disease: from computational nomination to pharmacological proof.
zh_title: AI赋能阿尔茨海默病药物重定位：从计算提名到药理验证
summary: 综述AI药物重定位在阿尔茨海默病中的应用，指出候选药物众多但临床转化尚未得到证实，并讨论大语言模型的作用。
key_points: 重定位药物占2026年AD管线158种中的56种
司美格鲁肽在evoke及evoke+中未延缓临床进展
评述四类证据域的能力与局限
reason: 综述类上限6；药物发现与痴呆方向略加分，无新数据
abstract: [Frontiers in pharmacology] Artificial intelligence (AI) has expanded the scale and speed of drug repurposing in Alzheimer's disease (AD). Transcriptomic signature matching, network-based systems pharmacology, real-world data pharmacoepidemiology and multi-omics machine learning have generated hundreds of candidate drugs, while repurposed agents account for 35% (56 of 158) of drugs and 42% (15 of 36) of Phase 3 agents in the 2026 AD pipeline. Clinical translation, however, remains unproven. Randomised trials of GLP-1 receptor agonists illustrate the gap between prioritisation and therapeutic proof: semaglutide did not slow clinical progression in evoke and evoke+, while liraglutide did not improve the primary FDG-PET endpoint in ELAD. We examine four complementary evidence domains, defining what each can and cannot establish, and position large language models as a cross-cutting tool for evidence synthesis and knowledge-graph reasoning rather than an independent source of biological evidence. Rather than cataloguing methods and candidates, we appraise leading drugs at the individual-molecule level and propose explicit criteria for progression from computational nomination to clinical testing. The framework defines seven requirements for clinical progression: disease-stage matching, adequate site-of-action exposure, including CNS exposure for central mechanisms, mechanistic validation in human-relevant models, biomarker-stratified trial design, convergence across independent evidence domains, causal inference with explicit boundary conditions, and mechanism-aligned endpoints with predefined stopping rules. AI has improved candidate prioritisation in AD, but clinical value will depend on converting ranked hypotheses into pharmacologically plausible and prospectively testable programmes.

title: AI Governance in Health Information Practice: A Practical Framework for HIPAA-Compliant AI Adoption.
source: PubMed · Advances in health information science and practice

summary: 提出将AI监督纳入现有HIPAA合规体系的实用治理框架，应对临床文书、编码等场景的隐私与安全风险。

abstract: [Advances in health information science and practice] Artificial intelligence (AI) tools are increasingly being integrated into health information workflows, including clinical documentation, coding support, revenue cycle operations, and patient engagement systems. While these technologies offer efficiency and enhanced decision support, their use introduces new privacy, security, and compliance risks when protected health information is entered as input, processed by third-party systems, or incorporated into AI-generated outputs. Existing Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) compliance structures do not address the complexities of AI-enabled environments, creating governance gaps that expose health care organizations to regulatory and operational risk. This article presents a practical governance framework that integrates AI oversight into existing HIPAA compliance programs. Drawing on compliance literature, regulatory guidance, and emerging AI governance models, the framework adapts core elements of the Office of Inspector General compliance model to address AI-specific risks. We proposed AI-centered policies and procedures, governance leadership, workforce training, auditing and monitoring, and incident response planning. This article provides implementation guidance tailored to health information practice, including workflow-based examples and phased adoption strategies. By positioning AI governance as an extension of established information governance responsibilities, health information professionals can proactively safeguard patient privacy, strengthen regulatory compliance, and support responsible innovation in AI-enabled health care environments.
zh_abstract: [Advances in health information science and practice] 人工智能（AI）工具正日益融入健康信息工作流程，包括临床文书、编码支持、收入周期运营和患者参与系统。这些技术虽能提高效率并增强决策支持，但当受保护的健康信息被作为输入、由第三方系统处理或被纳入 AI 生成的输出时，其使用会带来新的隐私、安全和合规风险。现有的《健康保险携带和责任法案》（HIPAA）合规架构未能应对 AI 环境的复杂性，造成治理空白，使医疗机构面临监管和运营风险。本文提出一个实用的治理框架，将 AI 监督整合到现有 HIPAA 合规项目中。该框架借鉴合规文献、监管指南和新兴的 AI 治理模式，调整了监察长办公室（Office of Inspector General）合规模型的核心要素，以应对 AI 特有的风险。我们提出了以 AI 为中心的政策与程序、治理领导层、员工培训、审计与监测以及事件响应计划。本文提供了针对健康信息实践的实施指导，包括基于工作流程的示例和分阶段采用策略。通过将 AI 治理定位为既有信息治理职责的延伸，健康信息专业人员可以主动保护患者隐私、加强监管合规，并支持 AI 赋能的医疗环境中的负责任创新。

title: Causally Constrained and Uncertainty-Aware Cardiopulmonary Risk Prediction
zh_title: 因果约束且不确定性感知的心肺风险预测
summary: 提出CE-Agent两阶段框架，将流行病学证据转为风险因子权重约束，并结合胸部CT表型预测肺癌与心血管风险。
key_points: 将已发表流行病学证据编码为权重约束
结合CT表型与队列数据估计基线风险
闭式不确定性传播可处理缺失输入
reason: 预印本，方法有新意，摘要未见外部验证细节
abstract: Routine chest computed tomography (CT) captures pulmonary, cardiac, and vascular phenotypes that jointly stratify lung cancer and cardiovascular disease, the two leading causes of death in lung-screening populations. Yet clinical risk calculators evaluate each disease in isolation and omit CT findings, whereas unconstrained machine learning overfits small hospital cohorts, learns treatment- and illness-confounded risk directions, and conceals uncertainty when patient records are incomplete. Here we present the Causal Envelope Agent (CE-Agent), a two-stage framework that compiles peer-reviewed epidemiological evidence into explicit constraints on risk-factor weights before any outcome is seen, while estimating local baseline risk and newly added CT phenotypes from cohort data. At deployment, closed-form uncertainty propagation accounts for missing clinical or CT inputs within milliseconds per patient, running over two orders of magnitude faster than Monte Carlo sampling and returning calibrated risk intervals that direct chart review and selective imaging to borderline patients. Across 53,452 lung-screening participants from 33 US hospitals and 6,814 multi-ethnic adults, CE-Agent outperforms cardiovascular calculators in lung screening, exceeds the Pooled Cohort Equations on hard atherosclerotic events while correcting their 1.7-fold risk overestimation, and generalizes from a single hospital or CT scanner to external sites while lowering required sample sizes up to fivefold. Applied unchanged to lung cancer, CE-Agent matches established screening models with accurate calibration even when restricted to risk-factor directions alone, and pairing both predictions improves joint cardiopulmonary triage from a single screening visit.
zh_abstract: 常规胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）可捕获肺部、心脏和血管表型，这些表型可共同对肺癌和心血管疾病进行分层，而这两者是肺癌筛查人群中的两大主要死因。然而，临床风险计算器对每种疾病孤立评估，且未纳入CT所见；而不受约束的机器学习则会在小型医院队列中过拟合，学到受治疗和疾病混杂影响的风险方向，并在患者记录不完整时掩盖不确定性。在此，我们提出因果包络智能体（Causal Envelope Agent，CE-Agent），这是一个两阶段框架：在观察任何结局之前，先将同行评议的流行病学证据编译为对风险因素权重的显式约束，同时从队列数据中估计本地基线风险和新增的CT表型。在部署时，闭式不确定性传播可在每例患者数毫秒内处理缺失的临床或CT输入，运行速度比蒙特卡洛抽样快两个数量级以上，并返回经校准的风险区间，用以指导对临界患者进行病历复核和选择性影像检查。在来自美国33家医院的53,452名肺癌筛查参与者和6,814名多民族成年人中，CE-Agent在肺癌筛查人群中优于心血管风险计算器，在硬性动脉粥样硬化事件上超过合并队列方程（Pooled Cohort Equations），同时纠正了其1.7倍的风险高估，并能从单一医院或CT扫描仪泛化到外部站点，所需样本量最多降低至五分之一。CE-Agent不作改动应用于肺癌时，即使仅限于风险因素方向，也能与成熟的筛查模型相当且校准准确；将两种预测结合可改善单次筛查就诊中的心肺联合分诊。

title: Cracks in Embeddings: Robustness and Stability of JEPA-Based Chest X-Ray Representations
zh_title: JEPA胸片表征的鲁棒性与稳定性研究
summary: 在78,468张ChestX-ray14上测试四种JEPA编码器，对抗攻击与图像扰动导致嵌入与AUROC显著下降，并检验对抗微调（预印本）。
key_points: 测试四种JEPA编码器、六类扰动
余弦相似度最低降至0.33
AUROC最多下降0.12
reason: 预印本，有对比的医学基础模型鲁棒性评估，但仅单数据集
abstract: Self-supervised Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) models are increasingly used for medical imaging, however there is a limited understanding about robustness of these models toward real-world image changes. We test four JEPA-based chest X-ray encoders, trained on 78,468 NIH ChestX-ray14 images, under six tests: two black-box adversarial attacks (SPSA, Boundary Attack), three image corruptions (Gaussian noise, brightness shift, contrast shift), and a label-scarcity test, measuring embedding change and classification AUROC. These perturbations cause severe, model-dependent damage: encoder-level Cosine Similarity drops as low as 0.33, and AUROC falls by as much as 0.12 in the worst case (I-JEPA under the Boundary Test). We test two ways of training the small predictor on top of each frozen encoder to address this. Adversarial fine-tuning, trained on clean and perturbed images together, raises embedding consistency above 0.97 in nearly every case and improves AUROC, relative to the same perturbed baseline, for most models, with the largest gain of $+0.10$ on I-JEPA. A Vector-Quantized codebook method, trained only on clean images and evaluated on perturbed test images for the first time, instead degrades under distortion for all four models, most noticeably for I-JEPA ($-0.15$ AUROC on average), showing that its discrete bottleneck alone does not provide the robustness that comes from training on perturbed data directly.

title: X-Strata: Separating Aneurysms and Overlapping Vessels into Layers from 2D X-ray Angiography
zh_title: X-Strata：从二维X线血管造影分离动脉瘤与重叠血管层
summary: 提出网络将血管造影分离为动脉瘤囊、前方与后方血管三层，并在三中心220例留出患者上评估。
key_points: 利用造影剂时序和双视角视差分层
以同次三维旋转血管造影投影标签训练
推理仅需二维电影序列；220例含122例外部
reason: 新方法含外部测试，但为预印本，规模有限
abstract: An X-ray angiogram sums every structure along a ray into one pixel. When vessels cross an aneurysm, they obscure part of it and mix their contrast into its filling curve. We present X-Strata, a network that separates a cine angiogram into three layers: the complete aneurysm sac, the vessels in front of it, and the vessels behind it. Contrast timing indicates how much each layer contributes to a pixel, and parallax between two views indicates their order, which a single view cannot determine. X-Strata first estimates the layers and their contrast curves, then uses the second view to assign vessels to the front or back layer, and lifts all layers into 3D. It learns from layer labels projected from same-session 3D rotational angiography, but needs only 2D cine runs and their acquisition geometry at inference. On 220 held-out patients from three centers (122 external), two-view X-Strata ranks first among 14 baselines, including VGGT and C$^2$RV, in recovering the sac where vessels overlap it (Dice 0.693 internal, 0.641 external) and in ordering the layers (balanced accuracy 0.703, 0.659). Its order accuracy exceeds that of all 11 end-to-end baselines by at least 4.1 points internally and 3.3 externally (Holm-adjusted $p < 0.001$) and grows with view separation. Recovered 3D sac surfaces have a median Chamfer distance of 0.34 mm on the internal cohort. X-Strata may therefore provide layered aneurysm and vessel information, including 3D sac shape, for patients who undergo only 2D angiography.
zh_abstract: X线血管造影将沿射线方向的所有结构叠加到同一个像素中。当血管与动脉瘤交叉时，它们会遮挡部分动脉瘤，并把自身的对比剂信号混入其充盈曲线。我们提出X-Strata，这是一种将电影式血管造影分离为三层的网络：完整的动脉瘤囊、位于其前方的血管以及位于其后方的血管。对比剂时序反映每一层对像素的贡献，两个视角之间的视差则反映各层的前后顺序，而单一视角无法确定这一点。X-Strata首先估计各层及其对比剂曲线，然后利用第二视角将血管分配到前层或后层，并将所有层提升至3D。它从由同次检查的3D旋转血管造影投影而来的分层标签中学习，但推理时仅需2D电影序列及其采集几何信息。在来自三个中心的220名留出患者（其中122名为外部）中，双视角X-Strata在血管与动脉瘤重叠处恢复动脉瘤囊（Dice：内部0.693，外部0.641）以及判定层序（平衡准确率0.703，0.659）方面，在包括VGGT和C$^2$RV在内的14个基线方法中均排名第一。其顺序准确率在内部比全部11个端到端基线至少高4.1个百分点，在外部至少高3.3个百分点（Holm校正后$p < 0.001$），并随视角间隔增大而提高。恢复的3D动脉瘤囊表面在内部队列中的Chamfer距离中位数为0.34 mm。因此，X-Strata可能为仅接受2D血管造影的患者提供分层的动脉瘤和血管信息，包括3D囊形态。

title: QCAP-VQA: Question-Conditioned Capped Prior-Mass Supervision for Medical Visual Question Answering
zh_title: QCAP-VQA：医学视觉问答的问题条件封顶先验质量监督
summary: 用分割候选生成的问题条件先验监督部分交叉注意力头，提升医学VQA对所问解剖结构的关注，准确率与基线相当。
key_points: 封顶先验质量目标仅在低于阈值时惩罚
用SLAKE结构框评估注意力，训练中不使用
reason: 多模态VQA新方法，有对比但准确率无提升，预印本
abstract: Medical visual question answering models can answer correctly without attending to the anatomy that the question names. Automatic region priors allow spatial supervision without expert masks, but they are noisy, and it is unclear how strongly they should shape attention and how their effect should be verified. We present QCAP-VQA, which supervises a subset of cross-attention heads with a question-conditioned prior built from ranked segmentation proposals. Its capped prior-mass objective penalizes insufficient attention inside the prior only below a threshold. We evaluate attention against SLAKE structure boxes that play no role in training, separating attention on the named anatomy from how attention shifts between questions about the same image. QCAP-VQA matches the accuracy of a baseline without spatial supervision (84.26% vs. 84.23%), and every evaluated prior-supervised model places more attention on the annotated structures. Over a 64-fold range of regularization strength, the capped objective keeps prior mass between 0.67 and 0.77, whereas a pooled region-mass objective drives it to 0.97 and loses accuracy. The cost lies in question conditioning: as the constraint widens or strengthens, attention shifts agree less with the expert-defined contrast. Across 13 configurations, prior-referenced and expert-referenced evaluation rank the models in largely opposite order (Spearman correlation of -0.87), and the capped models it favors track the prior's own errors. Because clinical use of medical visual question answering requires answers grounded in the queried anatomy, supervision from automatic priors should be judged against independent anatomical references.

title: Electrocardiographic Imaging via Posterior Sampling under Operator Discrepancy
zh_title: 算子偏差下基于后验采样的心电成像
summary: 提出OpDis-PS扩散后验采样器，对心电成像中前向算子的信号相关偏差建模，以重建心脏表面电位。
key_points: 针对呼吸、姿势与脂肪等导致的算子偏差
学习偏差与信号的依赖并修正前向算子
固定先验应对多种算子条件
reason: 有新意的方法预印本，证据有限
abstract: Electrocardiographic imaging (ECGI) reconstructs heart-surface potentials from body-surface potentials, an ill-posed inverse problem. Diffusion posterior samplers combine a learned prior with an explicit forward operator that they assume to be accurate. In ECGI this operator is only an estimate, because the body changes with respiration and posture, and body composition such as subcutaneous fat is rarely known for an individual patient. The resulting operator discrepancy is structured and depends on the heart signal. We introduce OpDis-PS, a diffusion posterior sampler that models this discrepancy instead of treating it as signal-independent noise. OpDis-PS learns how the discrepancy depends on the signal, folds this into a corrected forward operator, and reconstructs with a fixed prior across all operator conditions. We study two realistic sources of discrepancy, changing lung conductivity and an added subcutaneous-fat layer. Across both, OpDis-PS reconstructs more accurately than classical regularization and learned predictors, with its largest gains on held-out cardiac pathologies.
zh_abstract: 心电成像（ECGI）由体表电位重建心脏表面电位，这是一个不适定的逆问题。扩散后验采样器将学习得到的先验与显式前向算子相结合，并假定该算子是准确的。在 ECGI 中，该算子只是一个估计，因为身体会随呼吸和体位变化，而皮下脂肪等身体成分对个体患者而言很少已知。由此产生的算子偏差具有结构性，并取决于心脏信号。我们提出 OpDis-PS，一种扩散后验采样器，它对这种偏差进行建模，而不是将其视为与信号无关的噪声。OpDis-PS 学习偏差如何依赖于信号，将其纳入校正后的前向算子，并在所有算子条件下使用固定先验进行重建。我们研究了两种现实的偏差来源：肺电导率变化和额外增加的皮下脂肪层。在这两种情况下，OpDis-PS 的重建均比经典正则化方法和学习型预测器更准确，在留出的心脏病理数据上提升最大。

title: Where to Predict in Retinal OCT? Anatomy-Guided Target Selection for I-JEPA
zh_title: 视网膜OCT中预测何处？I-JEPA的解剖引导目标选择
summary: 研究在I-JEPA自监督学习中利用图像强度与视网膜分割引导目标区域选择，并与均匀掩码比较。
key_points: 保留I-JEPA架构与潜空间预测目标
比较解剖引导矩形、解剖形状与覆盖约束目标
以线性探测等评估表征
reason: 眼科自监督方法预印本，有对比，证据有限
abstract: Self-supervised learning aims to learn meaningful representations from unlabeled data, potentially allowing models to capture subtle anatomical variations across patients and reduce the amount of labeled data needed. Image-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (I-JEPA) learns by predicting target-region representations from visible context rather than reconstructing pixels. However, its uniform target placement does not account for the anatomical structure of retinal OCT, where retinal tissue occupies only part of each B-scan. We investigate anatomy-guided target selection using image intensity and predicted retinal segmentation while retaining the I-JEPA architecture and latent prediction objective. We compare anatomy-guided rectangular targets, anatomy-shaped targets and coverage-constrained placement with uniform masking, and evaluate the learned representations using linear probing for glaucoma classification on FairVision. We found that rectangular targets guided by image intensity achieved the highest linear-probe AUC in our comparisons. We show that anatomically meaningful target selection is promising for retinal OCT representation learning, while greater anatomical specificity did not consistently improve performance.
zh_abstract: 自监督学习旨在从未标注数据中学习有意义的表征，有望使模型捕捉患者间细微的解剖差异并减少所需的标注数据量。基于图像的联合嵌入预测架构（I-JEPA）通过由可见上下文预测目标区域的表征而非重建像素来进行学习。然而，其均匀的目标位置设定未考虑视网膜 OCT 的解剖结构，即视网膜组织仅占每幅 B 扫描的一部分。我们在保留 I-JEPA 架构和潜在空间预测目标的前提下，研究利用图像强度和预测的视网膜分割进行解剖引导的目标选择。我们将解剖引导的矩形目标、解剖形状目标和覆盖约束放置与均匀掩码进行比较，并在 FairVision 上通过青光眼分类的线性探测评估所学表征。我们发现，在我们的比较中，由图像强度引导的矩形目标获得了最高的线性探测 AUC。我们表明，具有解剖意义的目标选择对视网膜 OCT 表征学习具有前景，而更高的解剖特异性并未带来持续的性能提升。

title: Continuous Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation Using PPG From Methods to Clinical Translation
zh_title: 基于PPG的连续无袖带血压估计：从方法到临床转化综述
summary: 综述PPG无袖带血压估计的全链条，涵盖生理机制、PAT/PTT、机器学习、数据集、校准验证与临床转化。
key_points: PPG不直接测量动脉压，需间接推断
涵盖数据集、校准、验证与偏差
按证据强度评估已有研究
reason: 信息量较大的可穿戴综述，但属综述类
abstract: Continuous blood pressure (BP) monitoring could improve hypertension management by capturing changes that intermittent cuff measurements miss. Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely explored for cuffless BP estimation because optical sensors are inexpensive, wearable, and already present in many consumer and clinical devices. PPG, however, does not measure arterial pressure: BP is inferred from waveform characteristics or pulse timing, which also depend on vascular tone, arterial stiffness, sensor contact, motion, and individual physiology. This survey reviews PPG-based cuffless BP estimation along the full measurement chain, covering physiological mechanisms, waveform features, pulse arrival time (PAT), pulse transit time (PTT), machine-learning methods, datasets, calibration, validation, deployment, bias, and clinical translation. Studies are assessed by the strength of evidence they provide rather than by reported error alone, with particular attention to subject and temporal leakage, dataset imbalance, calibration dependence and drift, motion artifacts, and the gap between benchmark accuracy and reliable real-world measurement. The review finds that progress depends on more than better prediction algorithms. Future work should prioritize physiologically informed models, diverse longitudinal datasets, transparent reporting of calibration requirements and failure rates, stronger evaluation protocols, and studies that demonstrate practical value in clinical care.
zh_abstract: 连续血压（BP）监测可以捕捉间歇性袖带测量所遗漏的变化，从而改善高血压管理。光电容积描记（PPG）因光学传感器价格低廉、可穿戴，且已存在于许多消费级和临床设备中，被广泛用于无袖带血压估计。然而，PPG 并不直接测量动脉压：血压是根据波形特征或脉搏时间推断得出的，而这些特征同时也受血管张力、动脉僵硬度、传感器接触、运动及个体生理状况的影响。本综述沿完整的测量链回顾基于 PPG 的无袖带血压估计，涵盖生理机制、波形特征、脉搏到达时间（PAT）、脉搏传导时间（PTT）、机器学习方法、数据集、校准、验证、部署、偏倚以及临床转化。对各项研究的评估依据其所提供证据的强度，而不仅仅是报告的误差，并特别关注受试者泄漏和时间泄漏、数据集不平衡、校准依赖与漂移、运动伪影，以及基准测试准确性与可靠的真实世界测量之间的差距。综述发现，进展不仅取决于更好的预测算法。未来工作应优先考虑：基于生理学的模型、多样化的纵向数据集、对校准要求和失败率的透明报告、更严格的评估方案，以及能够证明临床实际价值的研究。

title: AI Applications in Aortic and Peripheral Artery Disease: Risk Prediction, Imaging, Procedural Support, and Longitudinal Surveillance.
zh_title: AI在主动脉与外周动脉疾病中的应用综述
summary: 综述AI在血管风险预测、影像分析、手术支持与随访监测中的应用，强调算法性能、外部验证、工作流影响与患者获益的区别。
key_points: 影像分割与腹主动脉瘤检测证据最成熟
AAA病例发现有非随机证据显示随访改善
区分算法性能与患者获益证据
reason: 专科综述，证据分级有信息量但属综述上限
abstract: [Methodist DeBakey cardiovascular journal] Aortic disease and lower-extremity peripheral artery disease (PAD) generate substantial morbidity, mortality, and longitudinal imaging burden. Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly studied for vascular risk prediction, image analysis, procedural support, and surveillance, but the maturity of these applications is heterogeneous. This review evaluates recent AI applications in aortic disease and PAD, emphasizing the distinction between algorithmic performance, external validation, demonstrated workflow impact, and proven patient benefit. Automated image segmentation and opportunistic abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) detection have the most mature evidence base, including retrospective external validation and, for AI-assisted AAA case finding, nonrandomized evidence of improved downstream evaluation and follow-up. Conversely, while machine-learning models for vascular risk prediction and disease progression often report high retrospective accuracy, their clinical readiness remains strictly investigational. Across most aortic and PAD applications, there is a persistent lack of independent external validation, decision-curve analysis, and prospective testing against standard care. Image-fusion guidance has clinical evidence for reducing procedural resource use, but this evidence should not be conflated with autonomous AI or robotic navigation. Cardiovascular digital twins remain largely mechanistic, computational, or early-development frameworks. AI can augment vascular imaging and risk assessment, but high retrospective accuracy is not equivalent to clinical utility. Current guideline thresholds for repair, revascularization, and surveillance should not be altered on the basis of investigational radiomics or prediction models. Translation requires multicenter external validation, prospective workflow evaluation, calibration and net-benefit assessment, transparent reporting, and trials demonstrating improved patient outcomes.

abstract: [Clinical and experimental gastroenterology] Gastric cancer remains a major global health burden, and chronic atrophic gastritis (CAG) and gastric intestinal metaplasia (GIM) are important premalignant conditions. The risk of progression, however, varies considerably between individuals, making reliable risk stratification central to decisions on surveillance. Histological staging remains the most established approach. In a recent meta-analysis of prospective cohorts, Operative Link on Gastritis Assessment (OLGA) stages III-IV and OLGIM (Operative Link on Gastric Intestinal Metaplasia Assessment) stages III-IV were associated with substantially higher risks of gastric cancer than stages 0-II, with risk ratios of 32.31 and 12.38, respectively. Endoscopic assessment adds information on the distribution of mucosal abnormalities and can improve biopsy targeting; an EGGIM score >4 has shown 95.7% sensitivity and 91.4% specificity for identifying OLGIM stages III-IV. Helicobacter pylori eradication reduces subsequent gastric cancer risk, but surveillance remains necessary in patients with advanced atrophy, extensive GIM, or previous gastric neoplasia. Serological biomarkers may help identify individuals who should undergo endoscopy, although variation in assay thresholds and population characteristics limits their use for definitive risk staging. Artificial intelligence is also being explored to improve diagnostic consistency. In a multicentre pathology study, a deep-learning model achieved external-test AUCs of 0.884 for intestinal metaplasia and 0.877 for atrophy. Current evidence therefore favours combining these approaches according to their clinical roles rather than treating them as interchangeable tools: histology remains the basis of risk staging, endoscopy refines mucosal assessment and biopsy, biomarkers are most useful for triage, and artificial intelligence may support interpretation. Whether such integrated strategies improve surveillance efficiency or clinical outcomes still requires prospective, externally validated studies.

abstract: [Molecules (Basel, Switzerland)] Anemia of inflammation (AI) is largely driven by interleukin-6 (IL-6)-induced hepcidin overproduction, which disrupts systemic iron homeostasis. Buteae monospermae Semen (BMS), the seeds of Butea monosperma (Lam.) Kuntze and a traditional Tibetan medicine, has long been used for blood-related disorders, yet its active constituents against AI remain unclear. Here, an integrated strategy combining ADMET screening, network pharmacology, deep learning-based affinity prediction, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, and in vitro validation was applied to 58 BMS-derived compounds. Forty-three candidates with acceptable ADMET profiles were retained, and their predicted targets were enriched in inflammation- and iron metabolism-related pathways, particularly IL-6/JAK2/STAT3 signaling. Two phenylpropanoid amides, compounds 16 and 21, were prioritized and shown to interact favorably with hepcidin-related regulatory targets. In IL-6-stimulated HepG2 cells, both compounds dose-dependently reduced hepcidin levels (EC50 = 2.486 and 14.49 μM), with therapeutic indices of 4.40 and 33.7, respectively. These findings identify BMS-derived phenylpropanoid amides as hepcidin-modulating candidates for AI and demonstrate an effective computational-experimental strategy for discovering bioactive compounds from traditional medicines.

abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Artificial intelligence (AI) is entering routine care through documentation tools, decision support, and hospital operations. The central question is whether these systems improve clinical work and patient care once embedded in routine workflows, not only whether they perform well on test data. This targeted narrative review follows AI from voice dictation and ambient documentation to operating room (OR) organization, using hysteroscopy as a clinical exemplar of the transition from technical performance to clinical utility. Evidence identified through targeted searches completed on 6 September 2026 was appraised with a framework that distinguishes image-level from patient-level results, internal from independent validation, and discrimination from clinical utility. Randomized trials and multisite observational data show modest, product-dependent benefits of clinician-reviewed ambient documentation; inaccuracies persist. Evidence for patient-message drafting derives from ratings of responses to public-forum questions and supports only bounded, supervised feasibility testing. In hysteroscopy, selected models discriminate well in narrowly defined tasks, but most studies are retrospective, image-level, or internally validated, and patient-level errors in high-risk categories are seldom reported. Reported gains in OR scheduling come largely from simulation. Safe implementation requires a defined clinical need, baseline measurement, subgroup-aware local validation, accountable review, and predefined criteria for expansion or withdrawal.
